front.title: The Sovereign AI Horizontal Memory (SAIHM) Protocol

abstract.t:
This document defines the Sovereign AI Horizontal Memory (SAIHM) protocol, a memory layer for AI agents. A SAIHM operator stores an agent's memory as encrypted cells bound to a post-quantum holder identity, records each state change in a public audit log, and supports revocable sharing contracts. The protocol defines an erasure operation with two stated erasure classes, intended to help an operator meet its obligations under Article 17 of EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR).
This revision specifies the custodial profile. The operator holds the holder's keys and performs all cryptography. The agent-side client holds no keys, runs no cryptography beyond TLS and keeps no store; it reaches the operator over HTTPS and exposes the protocol to the agent as eight Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. The document defines the operator obligations, the HTTPS binding, the eight tools, and the checks a conformant client applies to what the operator returns.
